tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search across Umesh Malik's blog posts (titles, summaries, tags). Returns matching posts with slug, title, URL, summary, tags and publish date. Use for topics like AI engineering, LLMs, RAG, Claude Code, fine-tuning, or web development.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Fetch the full Markdown of a blog post by its slug (as returned by search_posts), including frontmatter metadata. Returns clean, agent-readable Markdown.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: List the curated topic hubs (Claude Code, LLM Engineering, AI Coding Agents) with their URLs.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get Umesh Malik's professional profile — role, experience, skills, projects and contact — as the machine-readable llms.txt index.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_topics · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: search_posts, get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_topics · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: search_posts, get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
